Package io.github.lord_of_nothing.hud

Class TutorialOverlay

java.lang.Object
io.github.lord_of_nothing.hud.TutorialOverlay
All Implemented Interfaces:
UiElement
public class TutorialOverlay extends Object implements UiElement
Modal tutorial overlay that displays long, wrapped and scrollable text inside a bordered decorative frame using the shared HUD assets.
